intent: Rank the SNPs in gwas_assoc.tsv (columns: chromosome, SNP, position, association p-value) from the most significant (smallest p) to the least significant.
silent_error: GNU sort -n compares only the plain decimal prefix of a field and does not understand exponents (sort man page: '-g, --general-numeric-sort  compare according to general numerical value' versus '-n  compare according to string numerical value'). '1e-300' is read as 1, '2.5e-12' as 2, '0.0021' as 0.0021, so the faulted order is 0.0021, 0.048, 0.6, 1e-30, 1e-300, 2.5e-12, 3.2e-05, 4.1e-08, 7.7e-09: the strongest hits sit in the middle and at the end of the file and a nominal 0.0021 is ranked first. sort exits 0 without any message and the file looks sorted.
